name: Feuer
description: Olivia's servant, a purveyor of ossuary furniture who spied on the humans in Gavony and reports Harvesttide.

timeline.summary: Feuer wakes Olivia Voldaren to report that the humans are holding a festival to restore the balance of day and night.
timeline.quote: They're up to something. Trying to restore the balance of day and night, I believe.

timeline.summary: Feuer reports that he burned a vampire effigy, saw Arlinn Kord leading the search, and learned that the humans seem to have the Moonsilver Key.
timeline.quote: I recognized their leader. Arlinn Kord

timeline.summary: Olivia decides to let the festival proceed, saying never to interrupt someone doing your work for you.
timeline.quote: Never interrupt someone when they're doing your work for you.

relations.note: He reports to her as a servant.
relations.quote: "My most illustrious and powerful Lady Olivia Voldaren."

pages_say.description: Olivia's servant, a purveyor of ossuary furniture who spied on the humans in Gavony and reports Harvesttide.
